name: amlei-resume
description: A career-materials studio with independent resume and portfolio workflows built from real evidence.

displayDescription.en: Turns real experience into application-ready resumes and evidence-backed portfolios through independent, focused workflows.
displayDescription.zh: 从真实经历出发产出可投递简历与可信作品集：两个独立 Skill，分别负责筛选表达与项目证据。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想针对目标岗位写一份简历，请基于我的真实经历一步步帮我产出可投递的 A4 PDF。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me write a resume for my target role based on my real experience and deliver an application-ready A4 PDF.

quickPrompts.zh: 我想针对目标岗位写一份简历，请基于我的真实经历一步步帮我产出可投递的 A4 PDF。
quickPrompts.en: Help me write a resume for my target role based on my real experience and deliver an application-ready A4 PDF.

quickPrompts.zh: 这是我的现有简历和目标 JD，请帮我改到高度匹配，缺的证据直接追问我。
quickPrompts.en: Here is my current resume and the target JD. Tailor it for a strong match and ask me for any missing evidence.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我调研这个岗位的筛选标准，再告诉我简历各模块该突出哪些证据。
quickPrompts.en: Research what this role's screeners look for, then tell me which evidence each resume section should highlight.

quickPrompts.zh: 请根据我的项目材料重做一份作品集，缺哪些证据直接告诉我。
quickPrompts.en: Build an evidence-backed portfolio from my project materials and tell me what evidence is missing.
